name: Original Vancouver citizen
authoring: Procedural original geometry and baked procedural PBR, no external source assets
generator: Original build_citizen.py, Blender 4.5.12 LTS; texture optimization and re-export, Blender 4.3.2
runtimeNotes: In-place animation. Distance-driven clip sampling; each navigator owns its GLB and GPU resources. Keep procedural fallback until loading completes. Both legs obey reach bounds; shared continuous pelvis skinning aligns layered coat/denim deformation. Neck overlaps the compressed head. CPU tests sample 40 poses per clip for grounded soles and intact shin-to-ankle attachment.

provenance.method: Re-export of the original rigged citizen with three embedded 1024 PNG maps. Original triangles, UV connectivity, 22-bone rig and idle/walk/run clips preserved; 15 extra exported seam vertices.
provenance.acceptance: Accepted after High 1080p comparisons under four lighting conditions and an 8-second movement comparison.
provenance.benefit: 47.5% smaller GLB and 75% lower estimated RGBA8 texture allocation with full mip chains (64 to 16 MiB). No measured FPS improvement; one material draw and 37,799 triangles unchanged.
provenance.handoffInventory: Original optimization handoff files remain unchanged; runtime-reference preserves the former production input outside that inventory.
